name: smart-compact
description: Compacts the Claude Code context at the most cost-effective moment, aware of the warm prompt cache; Haiku judges task boundaries, topic switches and what to keep

softTokens.title: Assessment threshold (tokens)
softTokens.description: From this size Haiku decides after every turn whether to compact

hardTokens.title: Hard threshold (tokens)
hardTokens.description: From this size compact right after the turn

idleMinutes.title: Mid-work pause (min)
idleMinutes.description: How long to wait without new messages when the task is not finished; never longer than the cache lives

doneIdleSeconds.title: Pause after a finished task (s)
doneIdleSeconds.description: How long to wait when Haiku considers the task finished

helperModel.title: Helper model
helperModel.description: Classifier and author of the compaction notes; empty disables the helper

topicCheck.title: Compact on topic switch
topicCheck.description: Before a new message Haiku checks whether it starts a new task and compacts before it

coldTokens.title: Cold-cache threshold (tokens)
coldTokens.description: If the cache is cold and the context is larger than this, compact before the next message: the history would be re-read at full price anyway

cacheTtl.title: Cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto learns it from actual cache hits; 5m or 1h sets it
